name: Mr Beale's horse
summary: A drawing of a horse identified by the artist's shorthand as 'Mr Beale's'. Thomas Beale (c.1775-1841), a long-standing resident of Macau, was a dealer in opium and other commodities, who in 1816 was declared bankrupt, owing a huge sum to the East India Company. He lived on in Macau, collecting birds
